subtitle: The story of the night Jesus was born

scenes.title: An Angel Visits Mary
beats: In a little town called Nazareth lived a young woman named Mary. She loved God, and she was going to marry a carpenter named Joseph.
One day, a shining angel named Gabriel came to her. “Don’t be afraid, Mary,” he said. “God is so pleased with you!”
“You will have a baby boy, and you will name Him Jesus. He will be called the Son of God, and His kingdom will never end!”
Mary said, “I am the Lord’s servant. Let it happen just as you have said.”

scenes.title: The Road to Bethlehem
beats: Before the baby was born, the ruler of the land ordered everyone to go back to their family’s hometown to be counted.
So Joseph and Mary set out on the long road to Bethlehem — Mary riding on a little donkey, and Joseph walking beside her.

scenes.title: No Room
beats: When they reached Bethlehem, the town was full of people. Every room was taken. There was no room for them anywhere.
So they stayed in a place where the animals slept. And there, that very night, Mary’s baby was born — Jesus, the Son of God!
Mary wrapped Him snugly in soft cloths and laid Him in a manger, the wooden box where the animals ate their hay.

scenes.title: Angels in the Sky
beats: Out in the fields nearby, shepherds were watching over their sheep in the dark of night.
Suddenly an angel appeared, and God’s glory shone all around them! “Don’t be afraid,” the angel said. “I bring you good news of great joy for everyone!”
“Today a Savior has been born — Christ the Lord! You will find Him wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.”
Then the whole sky filled with angels, singing: “Glory to God in the highest, and peace on earth!”

scenes.title: The Shepherds Hurry
beats: The shepherds hurried off to Bethlehem — and they found Mary and Joseph, and the baby lying in the manger, just as the angel had said!
They told everyone what they had seen and heard. And Mary kept all these things close in her heart, and thought about them often.

scenes.title: The Star and the Wise Men
beats: Far away in the east, wise men saw a brand-new star shining in the sky. They knew it meant that a great King had been born.
They followed the star for many, many miles, until it stopped over the place where the child Jesus was.
They bowed down and worshiped Him, and gave Him their treasures: gold, frankincense and myrrh. Jesus had come — God’s greatest gift of all.

touch.hint: Tap the sky to add a star

questions: Why do you think God sent Jesus as a little baby?
The angels sang because they were so happy. What makes you happy about Jesus being born?
The wise men brought gifts to Jesus. What gift could you give to Jesus?

verse.text: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
